component.name: Puzzle Timer
component.summary: Speedcubing timer with scrambles for 200+ puzzles

description.p: A speedcubing timer for the GNOME desktop. Scrambles come from csTimer's module and cover more than 200 puzzle types, from 2x2x2 to the various shape mods, with a diagram where the puzzle has one.
Sessions keep their own scramble type, times carry penalties and comments, statistics cover averages and personal bests, and data files import from and export to csTimer.
The interface is available in English and Chinese.
This release is dedicated to porting the programming language to Rust. The UI, features and data compatibility are kept the same. No new features.
The TypeScript version is frozen on branch legacy.
This release adds scramble options, language support, data import and export, more statistics, and a session manager.

ul.li: Scramble types that have options get a dropdown arrow to change them.
A fast 4x4 option, only for the WCA 4x4x4 type, uses random moves instead of random state for faster scrambles.
A pre-scramble setting turns the scramble diagram to a certain orientation.
Language support, currently English and Simplified Chinese.
Import from and export to data files, aiming to be compatible with csTimer.net.
A session manager to rename, delete and reorder sessions, opened from the sidebar header.
Statistics improvements: averages, personal bests, activities, streaks, charts and histograms.

description.p: This release is mainly about improving existing features.

ul.li: Size scaling settings for the timer, the scramble text and the scramble diagram, which now grow continuously with the window instead of in discrete steps.
A button in the sidebar header to create a session, instead of an item in the session drop-down menu, and a fullscreen toggle in the menu.
The app menu is moved to the main header bar, and the session switcher is now in the sidebar's header.
Touching or clicking the scramble text no longer starts the timer; only the timer area is recognized, and multi-finger touches work.
The solve editor UI is adjusted to have a Cancel button and a Save button.
The inspection audio cues are disabled by default.

description.p: This release mainly adds touch support and a distraction-free mode.

ul.li: Start and stop the timer by mouse or touch.
A cancel button during inspection.
Starting an inspection no longer needs holding.
Distraction free during inspection and solve: hide everything except the timer.
The scramble diagram no longer covers the timer, and the layout no longer jumps back and forth at the threshold of the sidebar toggle.

description.p: First release ready for public use.

ul.li: A new icon, with a symbolic variant for small sizes, and a desktop entry.
The app is now called Puzzle Timer.

description.p: This release mainly contains improvements to features in previous releases.
As of this release, the app is much more polished and usable.

ul.li: The solve list in the sidebar shows ao5 and ao12.
The solve edit dialog is completely reworked with libadwaita widgets.
A header button copies the scramble text.
A header button changes the puzzle type from a pop-up dialog, replacing the two drop-down buttons.
The puzzle category and type are shown as the window's title and subtitle.
A header button toggles the scramble diagram.
All app menu items are in the sidebar.
Scramble diagrams render with Gtk.Svg instead of Rsvg.
An icon.
The timer centers in the available space, the type picker is faster, and the layout adapts to phones, including landscape.
The sidebar does not expand over 320 px, with no need for that much space.
The statistics table adapts to a narrow window for the phone form factor.
The solve list becomes a drawer for a narrow window.
The header adapts instead of truncating.
Phone form factor considerations, very basic and needing much more work later.

description.p: Scramble image, preferences and shortcuts dialog.

ul.li: The scramble diagram at the bottom right.
A preferences dialog with the inspection hold time, the sound of inspection cues and the app theme.
A shortcuts dialog.

description.p: Statistics dialog, penalties and WCA inspection.

ul.li: A stats dialog with ao5, ao12, mo3, etc.
+2 and DNF penalties and comments on solves, modifiable through a dialog.
WCA inspection: a 15-second countdown with cues at 8 and 12 seconds, +2 at 15 seconds, DNF at 17, and Escape to cancel.
Each session remembers its scramble type.
Create, rename, switch and delete sessions.
Each session has its own solve list, statistics and scramble type.
The solve list in the sidebar.
A button to delete one or more solves, able to undo.

description.p: Add scrambles from csTimer through cstimer_module.

ul.li: Scramble generation.
Prefetch the next scramble for better performance.
A two-level puzzle type selector.
GTK 4 with libadwaita through node-gtk, written in TypeScript.
Basic timer. Hold Space and release to start, press to stop.
